description: Bug #2 from the AS-7 first-fire shakeout (see AS-7 comment 2026-08-30). Deadlock in the lock protocol: apps/chat/watch/advance-watcher.mjs fire() acquires apps/chat/data/advance.lock (source:'watcher', watcher pid) BEFORE spawning claude -p '/advance'. The spawned tick runs advance.md step 0, sees a fresh lock it cannot attribute to itself, and no-ops. advance.md already says 'ticks fired by the message watcher skip this step' — but the spawned tick cannot detect that it IS watcher-fired: the headless invocation is byte-identical to a manual one. Every watcher-fired tick therefore self-cancels. Evidence: apps/chat/data/logs/tick-2026-08-30T18-08-30.241Z.log (tick exited 0, 'Tick ended as a no-op — lock is held', lock pid 17730 == live watcher pid). DESIGN (decided by cto-owen, rationale in plan): watcher passes ADVANCE_TICK_PARENT=watcher:<pid> in the tick child env; advance.md step 0 changes to: a lock whose source is 'watcher' AND whose pid matches ADVANCE_TICK_PARENT is YOUR lock — proceed, and do NOT release it (the watcher releases its own lock in settle() on tick exit); locks from any other source/pid are foreign — no-op. Requires widening the AS-14 env pin {PATH,HOME,USER,LOGNAME} by exactly this one documented variable in tickChildEnv() plus its pin test. Alternatives rejected: (a) watcher releases the lock pre-spawn and lets the tick take its own — opens a real race window between release and the child's step 0 where a manual tick or loop steals the slot, and breaks the watcher's settle()/timeout ownership semantics; (b) advance.md adopts ANY fresh source:watcher lock without a marker — misfires when a manual tick races a watcher fire: the manual tick would adopt the watcher's lock and proceed, defeating single-flight. The env marker is deterministic parent identification: no race, no ambiguity, one documented env var. advance.md is employee-editable; the step-0 wording change is in scope for the implementer.
title: Watcher-fired ticks self-cancel on the watcher's own advance.lock — pass ADVANCE_TICK_PARENT marker so the tick recognizes its parent's lock
